correctness.rationale: For every n,r, necessity uses transitive closure of cycle edges and positive components larger than r; sufficiency realizes every labeling by the positive-edge component partition. The exponential formula counts labeled bounded-component forests. The online union predictor has at most n-ceil(n/r) mistakes, matched by shattered forests. Facet maximality requires all pairwise component sums >r; sorted-size optimization gives minimal total ta-delta for t>=2, monotone component increments fill all intermediate totals, proving every stated facet size. Independent exhaustive finite tests and exact small online recurrence pass; finite evidence is corroboration only.

value.rationale: All-parameter structural identification of a natural equivalence-query shattering complex; a complete exponential generating polynomial; exact VC and online dimensions; and an exact contiguous maximal-face spectrum with linearly growing nonpurity for every fixed cap r>=3. The facet spectrum distinguishes bounded clustering concept classes from the ordinary uncapped graphic matroid and is a motivated invariant rather than an arbitrary finite calculation.
